$comment: PROPOSED format (SCH-006): not a frozen standard. It may change until stabilized by tests and an ADR. The Rust parser in crates/glint-schema (src/profile.rs) is authoritative where this schema and the parser disagree. Each entry pins one release as defined by proposed ADR 0006 (docs/adr/0006-package-identity-and-origin-collisions.md); every field, including the digest, is required, and a (kind, id) appears at most once (checked by the parser, not expressible here). Origins must be in canonical form.
title: Glint profile lock (profile.lock) v1
description: Exact releases pinned for one profile, so the profile resolves to the same bytes on every load.

$schema.description: Editor hint only; Glint never dereferences it.

kind.description: Package kind. Only "theme" exists in v1.

version.description: Exact semantic version (SemVer 2.0), not a range.

origin.description: Canonical origin: local, registry:<https-url>, git:<https-url>[#subpath] or artifact:<https-url>. No credentials, query or fragment in the URL.
